scene_name: 运动户外场景 — Sports Action
prompt: A dynamic action shot of {{product_name}} being used in an outdoor or athletic setting. The {{product_category}} is captured mid-use — motion, energy, and performance are the focus. {{product_description}} Bright natural daylight, blue sky, green field or mountain backdrop. The {{product_name}} is clearly visible despite the action, with sharp focus on the product. Athletic and energetic atmosphere. Inspires the viewer to get active. The {{product_materials}} look durable and performance-oriented. Features: {{key_features}}. Dynamic motion, outdoor adventure feel, peak performance moment.
negative_prompt: indoor setting, dark, night, rain, dirty, damaged, sedentary environment, office, couch, static, paused, bored expression, low energy, cluttered backdrop
style: Sports action photography, outdoor adventure editorial, athletic campaign, dynamic performance lifestyle
composition: Wide or medium shot capturing movement, subject in action, motion blur in background but product sharp, dynamic angle, dramatic perspective
lighting: Bright natural outdoor light, golden hour if possible, sun highlighting the product, clear blue sky, natural vivid colors, high contrast for energy
color_palette: Vibrant outdoor colors, sky blue (#87CEEB), grass green (#4CAF50), energetic accent colors, natural sunlight tones, high saturation for impact
